content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for a chair position at the Arctic Council. Tell about your experience in Arctic policy, indigenous peoples' rights, and climate change impacts. Also describe how you have promoted sustainable development in the Arctic region and built international cooperation. Length about 400 words.
